title: HTTP/1.1 chunk length is a number of hexadecimal bytes
summary: Numbers in chunk-size lines are interpreted in hexadecimal and do not include CRLF after the line, extensions, and data.
applies: HTTP representation and offline message parsing
detail: The length line a represents 10 data bytes. A zero-length block marks the end of a data block, which may still be followed by a trailer field.
boundary: This boundary is a transfer encoding and does not apply the same text syntax from HTTP/2's DATA frame.
relevance: Distinguish between actual payload and chunked markers when reconstructing offline response body.
